Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the distribution of funds to community health clinics.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the distribution of funds to community healthclinics; adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that community healthclinics are critical to providing preventive services and medicaltreatment, including prescription drugs, to lowincome people inWashington, and that the state should continue to support theseclinics. However, it is also essential that we protect the viabilityof our private health care providers, who are also fundamental to thehealth of our population and, especially in rural areas, the economicwellbeing of our communities. It is the intent of the legislaturethat community health clinics complement, and not compete with, privatehealth care services.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The authority shall distribute funds to a community health clinicthat provides its patients with outpatient prescription drugs covered p. 1 SSB 5885by section 340B of the public health services act only: (1) If theclinic has in effect a contract for pharmacy service between itself anda local retail pharmacy; or (2) upon proof that there is no retailpharmacy within ten miles of the clinic able and willing to contractwith the clinic to provide pharmacy services.
